name: planejamais
description: Conecta ChatGPT e Codex ao Planeja+ para consultar e atualizar planejamento estratégico, quadros de tarefas, reuniões, relatórios e tickets da sua empresa.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Planeja+ to review strategic plans, perspectives, objectives, initiatives and execution steps; manage Kanban boards, tasks and checklists; create calendar events; and read reports and support tickets. An existing Planeja+ account is required. Each call uses the selected company and the permissions of your role. Confirm destructive actions before execution.
defaultPrompt: Resuma o andamento das iniciativas do planejamento estratégico deste trimestre.
Crie as tarefas de acompanhamento da reunião de hoje no quadro do time.
Gere o relatório geral do planejamento e destaque os riscos.

positive.description: Company discovery. Setup: the dedicated reviewer account is the active owner only of the fictitious company Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao. It has no global administrator role or access to real customer companies.
positive.prompt: Quais empresas do Planeja+ posso acessar e qual e o meu papel em cada uma?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_my_companies. Return company names and roles supported by the response, including Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao. Use its returned id as companyId in subsequent cases. Do not invent or disclose inaccessible companies.

positive.description: Strategic plan drill-down. Setup: company Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao contains the plan Planejamento Demo 2026, its four default perspectives, and a sample objective and initiative. Supply the company context from case 1.
positive.prompt: Na empresa Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao, mostre as perspectivas, objetivos e iniciativas do Planejamento Demo 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named company and plan through discovery results. Call get_planejamento with the returned plan id and explicit companyId. Summarize perspectives, objectives and initiatives from the result; do not invent owners, dates or progress. No write tools are needed.

positive.description: Kanban task creation and verification. Setup: the reviewer is an owner only in Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao and a member of Acompanhamento Demo. The fixture already contains Revisar meta do trimestre, created once during the recorded preparation. Inspect existing tasks first; if an exact matching task exists, verify and report it without creating a duplicate. Creation is required only when absent.
positive.prompt: Na empresa Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao, crie a tarefa Revisar meta do trimestre com prioridade alta na coluna A fazer do quadro Acompanhamento Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve companyId, boardId and columnId from discovery. Inspect list_tasks for the selected board and A fazer column before writing. If Revisar meta do trimestre already exists, verify its title, column and priority alta and report that it is already saved; do not duplicate it. Otherwise call create_task with that title and priority alta, without assigning real users or adding unknown labels, then verify it in list_tasks. Report success only from actual results.

positive.description: Calendar event creation and verification. Setup: owner role only in Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao. The fixture already contains Revisao estrategica demo, created once during the recorded preparation. Inspect events first; verify the exact existing event without duplicating it. If absent, create it with only the creator, no other attendees, no generated meeting and no external notifications.
positive.prompt: Na empresa Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao, crie o evento Revisao estrategica demo em 15 de outubro de 2026 as 10h, sem outros convidados e sem gerar uma reuniao de video.
positive.expected_behavior: Use explicit companyId. Inspect list_events for 2026-10-15 and get_event for an exact existing Revisao estrategica demo; verify time 10:00, sole creator participant and no video meeting, and report it as already saved without duplication. If absent, call create_event with title Revisao estrategica demo, date 2026-10-15, time 10:00, type event, generateMeeting false and participantIds empty. Return actual results or explain the actual error; never claim success on failure.

positive.description: Period-filtered reporting. Setup: Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao has the fictitious plan and initiative described in case 2, dated within 2026. The report applies to the company, not to a plan-specific argument.
positive.prompt: Gere o relatorio geral da empresa Catalogo OpenAI - Demonstracao para o periodo de 1 de janeiro a 31 de dezembro de 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_relatorio_geral with explicit companyId and dateRange containing startDate 2026-01-01 and endDate 2026-12-31. Summarize returned totals and per-plan progress, preserving returned statuses. Do not invent totals, savings or risks unsupported by the result. No write tools are needed.

negative.description: Review context: use only Planeja+ connected to the dedicated demonstration account; do not use other plugins, external services or substitute actions. Unsupported financial execution. Expected: explain that the Planeja+ integration cannot execute bank transfers. Do not call create_event, create_task, create_ticket or other tools as a substitute for payment, and do not claim money was transferred.
negative.prompt: Transfira R$ 500 da conta bancaria da minha empresa para o fornecedor da iniciativa.

negative.description: Review context: use only Planeja+ connected to the dedicated demonstration account; do not use other plugins, external services or substitute actions. Unsupported external social publication. Expected: explain that the integration has no LinkedIn publishing tool and can help draft text in chat. Do not invoke Planeja+ mutation tools as a substitute or claim an external post was published.
negative.prompt: Publique agora no LinkedIn da empresa um anuncio de que concluimos nosso planejamento estrategico.

negative.description: Review context: use only Planeja+ connected to the dedicated demonstration account; do not use other plugins, external services or substitute actions. Unsupported external storage search. Expected: explain that this Planeja+ integration cannot search an unrelated Google Drive account. Do not invoke Planeja+ tools to claim access to external files or fabricate retrieved documents.
negative.prompt: Procure no meu Google Drive todos os PDFs sobre o planejamento e abra o mais recente.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not support purchasing, contracting or processing payments through its MCP server.

publication.release_notes: Adds the verified real ChatGPT demonstration video and reviewer-accessible playback page. Clarifies how reviewers inspect the existing task and event fixtures without duplication. Preserves the public logo, company-scoped customer access, support, approved privacy and terms pages, five positive and three negative cases, Portuguese translation and no-commerce declaration. The private development installation uses the same skill and MCP endpoint as this public package.

pt-BR.subtitle: Planejamento e tarefas
pt-BR.description: Conecte ChatGPT e Codex ao Planeja+ para consultar planejamentos, perspectivas, objetivos, iniciativas e etapas; gerenciar quadros Kanban, tarefas e checklists; criar eventos; e consultar relatórios e tickets. É necessário ter uma conta no Planeja+. Cada chamada usa a empresa escolhida e as permissões do seu papel. Ações destrutivas exigem confirmação antes da execução.
